answer: Pay emission from a stake-at-rest escrow, not from wallets. Each agent seat locks real capital in one escrow key, and seats are counted, not addresses, so a thousand free wallets still need a thousand funded escrows. Anyone may enter the open harbor, but a seat earns only after a challenge window where duplicate or zombie behavior burns the deposit. A voucher reputation nebula pushes slashing risk onto backers of fakes, so puppet clusters collapse. Durable karst of settled penalty history lets newcomers price risk first. Each marginal fake lifts attacker cost until payoff turns negative.
